About us

Workforce management, made simple.

At SublimeHR, we believe managing your workforce should be simple, efficient, and accessible from anywhere.

Our story

One platform for the work behind your people.

SublimeHR helps businesses streamline attendance, leave, shift scheduling, employee records, payroll and day-to-day HR operations — through a single, intuitive platform.

Whether you're a growing startup, a mid-sized business or a large enterprise, our goal is to eliminate manual processes, reduce admin overhead, and give your team more time for what matters most: growing your business.
